commitTrailers.Device-Id: 设备稳定 ID / stable device id
commitTrailers.Device-Name: 设备显示名称 / device display name
commitTrailers.Operation: 产生提交的操作 / operation that produced the commit
commitTrailers.Plugin-Count: 涉及的插件数量 / number of plugins involved
commitTrailers.Profile: DSH profile 名称 / DSH profile name

description: DSH 插件 Git 同步的备份布局 / Backup layout of DSH Plugin Git Sync. 此目录由插件自动维护，请勿手工修改 / maintained automatically; do not edit by hand.

files.README.md: 仓库说明 / human-readable repository notes
files.manifest.json: 备份索引 / index of the backup
files.profiles/<profile>/configs/<plugin-id>.j: 旧版配置目录，不再写入 / legacy config directory, no longer written
files.profiles/<profile>/plugins.json: 共享插件状态 / shared plugin state per profile
files.profiles/<profile>/skills/<skill-name>/: 已部署技能的真实文件 / deployed DSH skill files per profile

notes: 所有路径都相对于备份目录（默认是仓库根目录）/ all paths are relative to the backup directory (the repository root by default)
配置文件中的敏感键和疑似密钥的值不会被写入 / sensitive config keys and secret-looking values are never written
同一仓库被多个设备同时写入时，插件会重新拉取、合并并重试，绝不强制推送 / concurrent writes are re-merged and retried; the plugin never force-pushes
